summary: Implemented the second Repository Transition Validator lifecycle integration. pcae task finish --commit now requests a finish_task transition before canonical phase-report promotion, using the same shared phase-report transition adapter as pcae phase complete. Accept preserves the existing successful report flow; reject leaves latest.md/latest.json unchanged; quarantine writes only quarantine artifacts; requires_human_review blocks promotion. The 113S/113T asymmetry is repaired: stale phase-completion metadata, phase identity mismatch, missing recommended_next_phase, partial report evidence, explicit human review, and execution availability overclaims cannot become canonical latest reports through task finish. No push-check command integration, notification-dispatch enforcement, execution runtime, authorization, Permission Broker enforcement, plugin execution, Telegram inbound, REST, Web UI, or Dashboard was added. Execution capability remains unavailable.
tests_added_or_updated: 11 focused task-finish integration tests added; legacy task-finish and canonical-identity tests updated
